---
title: "Model Edit tools"
description: "Twelve tools that fit, align, project, cut, split and swap existing objects."
weight: 3

<!-- Generated by src/CommaTs/docs/site/scripts/convert-guide.mjs from src/CommaTs/docs/PluginGuide.html. Do not edit. -->

Applications & Components → Comma → Model Edit, and the two-row **Model Edit** block on the Comma ribbon tab. Tools that edit the geometry of existing objects. Most of them share one rhythm: set the options in the dialog, click **Apply**, pick a reference, then pick the targets (or preselect them before you click Apply); the command repeats until <kbd>Esc</kbd>. *Section Cutter* and *Remove Bools* have dialogs of their own, described in their sections. The five rebar tools (*Rebar Hook*, *Rebar Shape*, *Rebar Match*, *Rebar Stack* and *Rebar Interleave*) are listed here too, but they are placed from Comma → Rebar and the **Rebar** block of the ribbon tab. Gap fields accept arithmetic such as (2+3)\*4 and imperial feet/inch fractions, according to XS\_IMPERIAL\_INPUT when the dialog opens.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
Each change is a native Tekla modify: if an error stops a run, earlier changes can remain, so inspect the model and use **Undo** before retrying. These tools are new in this release: try them on a copy of your model first.
{{% /callout %}}
